scope: Exactly 27 blocked EDU alpha IDs; no duplicate alpha records created.
novelty_scope: All 27 source-level entry rules were individually reviewed against the current 30 other alpha records and pairwise within the 27. No identical primary entry definition or same-indicator/same-trigger strategy remains. Closely related families are listed per row with their operational distinction.
novelty_limit: Rule-level distinctness is not proof of statistical or economic independence. Candlestick, range-structure, gap, volatility, and flow ideas can remain related at a broader taxonomy level; performance correlation requires real backtest outputs.
evaluation: No profitability or runtime-engine claim. Backtest is a separate gate and has not run.

results.primary_signal_family: Williams %R bullish divergence and structural reclaim
results.thesis: A lower price trough with a higher Williams %R trough signals weakening downside momentum; enter only after price confirms by reclaiming the previous high.
results.entry_rule: Recent five-bar price low is below the preceding five-bar low, Williams %R low is higher, and close crosses above previous high while Williams %R is above -50.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the prior five-bar price trough.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses paired price/oscillator trough divergence plus a separate price confirmation, not a simple oversold threshold cross.
results.comparison_difference: Williams %R price/oscillator trough divergence with structural confirmation, not Stochastic K/D or RSI threshold rebound.

results.thesis: Auction-gap exhaustion: fade only a material opening gap down that is fully reclaimed by the close.
results.entry_rule: Open is at least 1% below prior close and current close recovers above that prior close.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the prior bar low.
results.novelty_rationale: A discrete open-to-prior-close dislocation and same-bar recovery; unlike the existing continuous trend, channel and momentum systems.
results.comparison_difference: A discrete open-to-prior-close dislocation and full same-bar gap reclaim, not cumulative multi-day return or ROC exhaustion.

results.thesis: Trade directional movement only when net displacement is large relative to the absolute path travelled.
results.entry_rule: Ten-bar absolute log-return efficiency crosses above 0.45 while ten-bar net displacement is positive.
results.exit_rule: Efficiency falls below 0.20 or ten-bar net displacement turns negative.
results.novelty_rationale: Measures path smoothness as net movement divided by total movement; it is not an EMA, regression-slope, ROC-threshold or channel signal.
results.comparison_difference: Net displacement divided by total absolute path, not EMA slope or regression-channel deviation.

results.thesis: A two-candle reversal requires a bearish prior real body followed by a bullish body that engulfs it.
results.entry_rule: Previous candle is bearish; current candle is bullish, opens at/below prior close and closes above prior open.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the prior candle low.
results.novelty_rationale: The primary event is a two-body engulfing pattern; no moving-average alignment or oscillator threshold is used.
results.comparison_difference: The 30 existing records have no real-body engulfing pattern; this uses prior bearish/current bullish body containment reversal.

results.thesis: A failed downside auction is a bear trap only when price trades below the previous low and closes back above that level.
results.entry_rule: Low sweeps the previous low, then the candle closes above that previous low and above its open.
results.exit_rule: Close loses the swept prior-low level.
results.novelty_rationale: Requires an intrabar low sweep followed by a close reclaim; differs from close-only moving-average re-entry and channel-break exits.
results.comparison_difference: Requires an intrabar low sweep and close reclaim of that exact prior low; neither channel exit nor multi-day close-return dip uses that event.

results.thesis: Use price-and-volume money flow to confirm a recovery from selling pressure.
results.entry_rule: MFI(14) crosses above 20 while the candle closes above its open.
results.exit_rule: MFI crosses below 50 or close falls below the prior low.
results.novelty_rationale: MFI weights typical-price direction by volume; this is not OBV's signed-volume accumulation rule.
results.comparison_difference: MFI price-weighted money flow threshold recovery, not OBV signed-volume accumulation plus RSI.

results.thesis: A narrowest-in-four-bars candle marks local compression; enter only on a bullish close through that candle's high.
results.entry_rule: Previous true range is smaller than the three ranges before it, and current close crosses above previous high.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the low of the compression candle.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses a one-bar NR4 auction pattern and its high/low as the trigger, not rolling volatility bands or a Donchian period breakout.
results.comparison_difference: The narrowest true range among exactly four bars followed by a one-bar break, not a rolling channel or NATR breakout.

results.thesis: Sustained closes near candle highs indicate persistent buying pressure even without volume confirmation.
results.entry_rule: Three-bar sum of close-location values crosses above 1.5.
results.exit_rule: Three-bar pressure sum falls below zero.
results.novelty_rationale: Aggregates where each close sits inside its own candle range; unlike price averages, volatility bands or volume-flow indicators.
results.comparison_difference: Three-bar close-location pressure derived only from OHLC, not OBV/volume flow.

results.thesis: A directional opening imbalance is continuation only if buyers hold the gap and finish the candle strong.
results.entry_rule: Open is at least 0.5% above prior close, close stays above prior close, and close is in the top 20% of the candle.
results.exit_rule: Close loses prior close or closes below the candle midpoint.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses open-gap persistence plus intrabar close location, not DI/ADX or a rolling-price breakout.
results.comparison_difference: Positive opening gap acceptance with close-location confirmation, not rolling-channel or macro-filtered breakout.

results.thesis: A lower-tail rejection signals buyers absorbed an intrabar selloff and reclaimed the candle body.
results.entry_rule: Bullish candle with lower wick at least twice the real body and close in the upper half of its range.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the rejection candle low.
results.novelty_rationale: Reads wick/body geometry within one candle; it is not a moving-average or volatility crossover.
results.comparison_difference: A one-bar lower-wick/body geometry trigger; the existing 30 contain no candlestick-wick pattern.

results.thesis: Fade a statistically exceptional one-bar loss only after a bullish close confirms immediate rejection.
results.entry_rule: Previous one-bar log return is below -2 rolling standard deviations; current candle closes bullish.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the shock candle low or the previous close is reclaimed.
results.novelty_rationale: Standardizes a one-bar log-return tail event; it does not use a price band, RSI or multi-day cumulative dip.
results.comparison_difference: A lagged standardized one-bar log-return tail shock and next-bar rejection, not price-band overextension or RSI rebound.

results.thesis: A mother-bar/inside-bar sequence defines a local auction boundary; only an upside close through the mother high enters long.
results.entry_rule: Previous candle is inside the candle before it; current close crosses above the mother-bar high.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the mother-bar low.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses nested high-low containment and a two-bar reference range, not a rolling channel or volatility-band threshold.
results.comparison_difference: Nested two-bar high/low containment and mother-bar resolution, not an N-bar channel high.

results.thesis: An outside candle that engulfs both sides of the prior range but closes bullish represents a full intrabar reversal.
results.entry_rule: Current high exceeds prior high, current low undercuts prior low, and current bullish close exceeds prior close.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the outside candle low.
results.novelty_rationale: Requires a two-sided range expansion and bullish resolution; unlike MACD momentum confirmation or one-sided breakouts.
results.comparison_difference: Two-sided outside-range expansion with bullish close acceptance; not close-only range-percent breakout or one-sided channel breakout.

results.thesis: A three-step sequence of higher swing lows signals rising demand; confirmation requires a close above the prior bar high.
results.entry_rule: Three successive lows rise and close crosses above previous high.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the previous low.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses an ordered swing-low structure and local confirmation, not a moving-average, ROC or oscillator regime.
results.comparison_difference: Ordered rising lows plus local high confirmation, not moving-average alignment or EMA slope.

results.thesis: A two-candle piercing reversal requires the second bullish body to recover more than half of the prior bearish body.
results.entry_rule: After a bearish candle, bullish current close opens below prior close and finishes above the prior-body midpoint but below prior open.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the two-bar pattern low.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses body-midpoint recovery after a bearish impulse; unlike stochastic or RSI oversold crosses.
results.comparison_difference: Two-candle bearish-body midpoint recovery, not RSI or Stochastic oscillator threshold recovery.

results.thesis: A three-candle morning-star sequence waits for a bearish impulse, a small indecision body, then a bullish midpoint reclaim.
results.entry_rule: Two bars ago is bearish and wide; prior body is small; current bullish close reclaims the first body's midpoint.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the three-bar pattern low.
results.novelty_rationale: Requires a three-stage decline/indecision/reclaim sequence, distinct from single-threshold CCI recovery.
results.comparison_difference: Three-stage bearish impulse, small-body pause, then midpoint reclaim; not a single oscillator snapback.

results.thesis: Two lows testing nearly the same price, followed by a bullish close, mark a repeated support rejection.
results.entry_rule: Current low is within 0.15% of prior low, prior candle is bearish, and current candle closes bullish above prior high.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the lower of the two test lows.
results.novelty_rationale: A repeated-price support test is the signal; no RSI strength threshold or moving-average regime is used.
results.comparison_difference: Adjacent-bar nearly equal lows followed by break of that bar's high, not a rolling channel or cumulative return dip.

results.thesis: A three-close selloff is actionable only after price reverses the local auction and closes above the previous bar high.
results.entry_rule: Three prior closes decline consecutively; current candle closes bullish above the previous high.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the previous low or a two-close decline resumes.
results.novelty_rationale: Combines a defined multi-bar selling streak with a separate structural reclaim; it is not a generic oscillator threshold.
results.comparison_difference: A discrete four-close selloff sequence with bullish close above the previous high, not a cumulative return threshold or ROC surge.

results.thesis: Weight each close-to-close return by traded volume so large price moves on high activity matter more than small moves.
results.entry_rule: Five-bar volume-weighted log-return flow crosses above zero.
results.exit_rule: Five-bar volume-weighted log-return flow crosses below zero.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses continuous return magnitude times volume rather than OBV's signed volume; it is not close-location pressure.
results.comparison_difference: Continuous log-return magnitude multiplied by volume, not OBV's signed volume accumulation.

results.thesis: After an exceptional one-bar downside excursion, require the next close to recover the prior candle midpoint before entering.
results.entry_rule: Prior true range exceeds twice its 20-bar average and current close reclaims the prior candle midpoint.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the shock candle low.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses a lagged true-range shock and exact candle-midpoint recovery, not Bollinger-band reclaim or ROC momentum.
results.comparison_difference: A lagged true-range shock followed by midpoint reclaim, not volatility expansion/breakout continuation.

results.thesis: A bearish mother candle followed by a bullish real body contained within it marks selling contraction; a later close through the mother high confirms resolution.
results.entry_rule: Previous candle is bullish harami inside the bearish candle two bars back; current close crosses above the mother high.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the lower of the harami and mother-bar lows.
results.novelty_rationale: Separates containment from confirmation across different bars, unlike an inside-bar pattern or same-bar engulfing reversal.
results.comparison_difference: A bullish real body inside a bearish mother real body, with confirmation on a later bar; not an N-bar price channel.

results.thesis: Unusually high volume with a small real body and close near the high suggests sell pressure was absorbed rather than accepted lower.
results.entry_rule: Volume z-score exceeds 2, real body is under 20% of range, and close is in the top quarter of the candle.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the absorption candle low.
results.novelty_rationale: Measures high effort with low directional price impact and bullish resolution; not a volume-spike trend crossover or OBV mean cross.
results.comparison_difference: High effort with low real-body impact and upper-range close, not volume-spike trend confluence or OBV direction.

results.thesis: Compare the magnitude of bullish and bearish real bodies over five bars to detect sustained directional auction control.
results.entry_rule: Bullish real-body sum crosses above twice the bearish real-body sum.
results.exit_rule: Bullish body sum falls below bearish body sum.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses body displacement separated by direction, not opening gaps, close-location pressure or a price-average cross.
results.comparison_difference: Separate five-bar bullish/bearish real-body magnitudes, not close-return ROC momentum.

results.thesis: When downside-return risk contracts sharply from its recent baseline and price has recovered over five bars, the market may be transitioning out of a stressed selloff.
results.entry_rule: Ten-bar mean squared negative log return crosses below half its value five bars earlier while five-bar price return is positive.
results.exit_rule: Downside semivariance returns above its five-bar-lagged level or five-bar price return turns negative.
results.novelty_rationale: Measures only the second moment of negative returns and its contraction; unlike full-range NATR/standard-deviation breakouts or one-bar failed-breakdown patterns.
results.comparison_difference: Downside-only return semivariance contraction plus positive five-bar recovery, not full-range volatility expansion or channel breakout.

results.thesis: A second low retesting a prior multi-bar trough after an intervening rebound is a structural support test, not a one-bar wick signal.
results.entry_rule: The recent three-bar trough is within 0.3% of an earlier three-bar trough, an intervening three-bar rebound exceeds both troughs by 0.5%, and close breaks above that rebound high.
results.exit_rule: Close breaks below the lower of the two troughs.
results.novelty_rationale: Requires separated trough windows and a later breakout confirmation; unlike the adjacent-bar tweezer pattern.
results.comparison_difference: Two separated trough windows, measured intervening neckline rebound, and neckline break; not a channel exit or one-window cumulative return dip.

results.thesis: Two consecutive candles with large lower tails indicate repeated intrabar rejection; entry waits for a separate bullish confirmation bar.
results.entry_rule: Previous two candles each have lower wick at least as large as their real body; current candle closes bullish above prior high.
results.exit_rule: Close falls below the lowest low of the three-bar pattern.
results.novelty_rationale: Requires two consecutive wick rejections and a third-bar confirmation; distinct event sequence from single-bar hammer.
results.comparison_difference: Two consecutive lower-tail rejections plus a third-bar confirmation; the existing 30 contain no multi-bar wick sequence.

results.thesis: Three consecutive bullish candles with progressively larger real bodies indicate increasing buyer commitment.
results.entry_rule: Three consecutive candles are bullish and each real body is larger than the preceding body.
results.exit_rule: Two consecutive bearish candles or close below the three-bar pattern low.
results.novelty_rationale: Uses candle-body expansion and direction, not a moving-average cross or generic close-return momentum.
results.comparison_difference: Three bullish real bodies strictly increasing in size, not close-return ROC surge or EMA rising-slope.
